note: Public eval set (docs/eval.md). Labels drafted by Claude Code from the source PDFs, read with an independent extractor (pypdf), and checked by hand. A label counts only once Steven approves it (status 'approved'): hard rule 10. All 40 were approved by Steven on 24 Nov 2026 (every one agreed as proposed). 'also_acceptable' lists other verdicts the definitions in docs/verdicts.md allow; the strict score ignores it. 'seen_in_tuning' marks claims from the UAT of 23 Nov 2026 that prompts were tuned against; they are never held out. 'expected_quote' is a short span of the source the evidence should come from, used to measure retrieval; null when no source text decides it.

claims.claim: He et al. (2016) evaluated residual networks with a depth of up to 152 layers on ImageNet, eight times deeper than VGG nets.
claims.expected_quote: we evaluate residual nets with a depth of up to 152 layers
claims.notes: Abstract: up to 152 layers, 8x deeper than VGG nets.

claims.claim: Ensembel jaringan residual mencapai galat top-5 sebesar 3,57% pada set uji ImageNet dan meraih juara pertama pada kompetisi klasifikasi ILSVRC 2015 (He dkk., 2016).
claims.expected_quote: Our ensemble has 3.57% top-5 error on the ImageNet test set, and won the 1st place in the ILSVRC 2015 classification competition
claims.notes: Indonesian decimal comma 3,57 = 3.57.

claims.claim: He et al. (2016) report that their 152-layer residual network has higher complexity than VGG nets.
claims.expected_quote: while still having lower complexity than VGG nets
claims.notes: Source says lower complexity, the opposite.

claims.claim: BERT dilatih awal menggunakan BooksCorpus (800 juta kata) dan Wikipedia bahasa Inggris (2.500 juta kata) (Devlin dkk., 2019).
claims.expected_quote: English Wikipedia (2,500M words)
claims.notes: Indonesian thousands separator 2.500 = 2,500.

claims.claim: BERT pushed the GLUE score to 90.5%, a 7.7 point absolute improvement (Devlin et al., 2019).
claims.expected_quote: pushing the GLUE score to 80.5% (7.7% point absolute improvement)
claims.notes: Source: 80.5%. The 7.7 point part is right, so Partial is defensible.

claims.claim: BERT mencapai akurasi MultiNLI sebesar 86,7% dan skor F1 SQuAD v1.1 sebesar 95,2 (Devlin dkk., 2019).
claims.expected_quote: MultiNLI accuracy to 86.7% (4.6% absolute improvement)
claims.notes: MultiNLI 86.7 is right; SQuAD v1.1 F1 is 93.2, not 95.2.

claims.claim: Adam is straightforward to implement, computationally efficient and has little memory requirements (Kingma & Ba, 2015).
claims.expected_quote: is computationally efficient, has little memory requirements

claims.claim: Pengaturan bawaan yang disarankan untuk optimizer Adam adalah α = 0,001, β1 = 0,9, β2 = 0,999 dan ε = 10^-8 (Kingma & Ba, 2015).
claims.expected_quote: Good default settings for the tested machine learning problems are α = 0.001, β1 = 0.9, β2 = 0.999
claims.notes: The PDF's epsilon has no Unicode mapping (shows as the unreadable-symbol placeholder).

claims.claim: Kingma dan Ba (2015) menyatakan bahwa Adam memerlukan memori yang besar sehingga tidak cocok untuk masalah dengan data berukuran besar.
claims.expected_quote: has little memory requirements, is invariant to diagonal rescaling of the gradients, and is well suited for problems that are large in terms of data
claims.notes: Source: little memory, well suited for large problems.

claims.claim: Goodfellow et al. (2014) showed that samples from generative adversarial nets are clearly better than samples from all existing generative models.
claims.expected_quote: While we make no claim that these samples are better than samples generated by existing methods
claims.notes: They claim only 'competitive with the better models'.

claims.claim: Kerangka kerja jaringan adversarial generatif berhubungan dengan permainan minimax dua pemain (Goodfellow dkk., 2014).
claims.expected_quote: This framework corresponds to a minimax two-player game.

claims.claim: Goodfellow et al. (2014) trained their generative adversarial nets on more than one million ImageNet images.
claims.expected_quote: We trained adversarial nets an a range of datasets including MNIST
claims.notes: Datasets are MNIST, TFD and CIFAR-10; ImageNet appears only in the bibliography. Listing other datasets is arguably a different value (Contradicted).

claims.claim: The proposed architectures can learn high quality word vectors from a 1.6 billion word dataset in less than a day (Mikolov et al., 2013).
claims.expected_quote: it takes less than a day to learn high quality word vectors from a 1.6 billion words data set

claims.claim: Mikolov dkk. (2013) mengusulkan dua arsitektur model baru untuk menghitung representasi vektor kata yang kontinu dari kumpulan data yang sangat besar.
claims.expected_quote: We propose two novel model architectures for computing continuous vector representations of words from very large data sets.

claims.claim: Applied to a state-of-the-art image classification model, Batch Normalization achieves the same accuracy with 14 times fewer training steps (Ioffe & Szegedy, 2015).
claims.expected_quote: Batch Normalization achieves the same accuracy with 14 times fewer training steps
claims.notes: Keeps the condition, unlike E16.

claims.claim: Batch Normalization sepenuhnya menghilangkan kebutuhan akan Dropout (Ioffe & Szegedy, 2015).
claims.expected_quote: in some cases eliminating the need for Dropout
claims.notes: 'Sepenuhnya' (entirely) overstates 'in some cases'.

claims.claim: An ensemble of batch-normalized networks reached 3.9% top-5 validation error on ImageNet (Ioffe & Szegedy, 2015).
claims.expected_quote: reaching 4.9% top-5 validation error (and 4.8% test error)
claims.notes: Source: 4.9%.

claims.claim: Distilasi pengetahuan menurunkan biaya inferensi sebesar 90 persen pada aplikasi seluler (Hinton dkk., 2015).
claims.notes: No inference-cost figure or mobile application in the paper.

claims.claim: Hinton et al. (2015) showed that distilling an ensemble into a single model can significantly improve the acoustic model of a heavily used commercial system.
claims.expected_quote: improve the acoustic model of a heavily used commercial system

claims.claim: RAG menggabungkan model seq2seq terlatih sebagai memori parametrik dengan indeks vektor padat Wikipedia sebagai memori non-parametrik (Lewis dkk., 2020).
claims.expected_quote: the non-parametric memory is a dense vector index of Wikipedia

claims.claim: RAG set the state of the art on three open domain question answering tasks (Lewis et al., 2020).
claims.expected_quote: set the state of the art on three open domain QA tasks

claims.claim: Lewis dkk. (2020) menemukan bahwa model RAG menghasilkan bahasa yang kurang faktual dibandingkan baseline seq2seq yang hanya parametrik.
claims.expected_quote: RAG models generate more specific, diverse and factual language than a state-of-the-art parametric-only seq2seq baseline
claims.notes: Source: more factual, the opposite.

claims.claim: On the Cora dataset, the graph convolutional network reached a classification accuracy of 91.5% (Kipf & Welling, 2017).
claims.expected_quote: GCN (this paper) 70.3 (7s) 81.5 (4s)
claims.notes: Table 2: 81.5. A table case.

claims.claim: Model GCN berskala linear terhadap jumlah sisi graf (Kipf & Welling, 2017).
claims.expected_quote: Our model scales linearly in the number of graph edges

claims.claim: Kipf and Welling (2017) evaluated their model on three citation network datasets: Citeseer, Cora and Pubmed.
claims.expected_quote: We consider three citation network datasets: Citeseer, Cora and Pubmed
claims.notes: They also use NELL (a knowledge graph), which the claim does not deny.

claims.claim: Sutskever et al. (2014) reported a BLEU score of 34.8 on the WMT'14 English-to-French translation task.
claims.expected_quote: the translations produced by the LSTM achieve a BLEU score of 34.8 on the entire test set

claims.claim: Sutskever dkk. (2014) melaporkan skor BLEU 34,8 pada tugas terjemahan Inggris-Prancis WMT'14, meskipun LSTM kesulitan menangani kalimat panjang.
claims.expected_quote: Additionally, the LSTM did not have difficulty on long sentences.
claims.notes: BLEU part right; 'struggled on long sentences' is the opposite of the source.

claims.claim: Ketika LSTM digunakan untuk memeringkat ulang 1000 hipotesis dari sistem SMT, skor BLEU meningkat menjadi 36,5 (Sutskever dkk., 2014).
claims.expected_quote: When we used the LSTM to rerank the 1000 hypotheses produced by the aforementioned SMT system, its BLEU score increases to 36.5

claims.claim: In one study, 55% of the citations generated by GPT-3.5 were fabricated, compared with 18% for GPT-4 (Walters & Wilder, 2023).

claims.claim: Walters and Wilder (2023) found that GPT-4 no longer produces any fabricated citations.
claims.expected_quote: but just 18% of the GPT-4 citations are fabricated
claims.notes: 18% of GPT-4 citations are fabricated.
